1.
Retroreflectivity data collection 2026
26.0000130165.0518- Retroreflectivity data collection 2026
Tenders are invited to submit their tenders to provide Professional Services for The existing retroreflectivity survey contract, originally established in 2017, has been extended multiple times and is due to expire in September 2026.
Timely and accurate Retroreflectivity data is essential for asset management, planning, prioritisation and performance monitoring.
This project will establish a panel of service providers to deliver annual retroreflectivity surveys and associated data in accordance with TfNSW QA Specification M921.
Data will be collected between November and June each financial year, and data delivered in specified formats, as per RMS Specification M921 Measurement of Longitudinal Linemarking by Mobile Retroreflectometer.
A pre-tender meeting will be held at 11AM - 12PM on Tuesday, 18 August 2026 by Virtual Teams Meeting. Attendance is mandatory to submit a conforming Application.
All tenderers must comply with the Transport Statement of Business Ethics through the procurement process and any subsequent contract period.
All tenderers must comply with the NSW Government Procurement Policy Framework, NSW Government Supplier Code of Conduct and New South Wales Industrial Relations Guidelines: Building and Construction Procurement.
